name: Content & Video Planning
description: Turn real work and audience needs into content worth making.
whenToUse: You need an achievable content direction or a plan for one video.
Existing content needs diagnosis based on supplied examples and results.
whatToProvide: The audience, goal, available source material and realistic production capacity.
Examples, performance data or references when available.
whatYouGet: A focused content plan or filmable video outline.
A rationale, reusable source material and a useful next iteration.
examplePrompts: Plan one 45-second demo for our CSV duplicate checker. I have a screen recording and can record voiceover. No customer results yet.
exampleInput: Plan one 45-second demo for our CSV duplicate checker. I have a screen recording and can record voiceover. No customer results yet.
exampleOutput:
0–6s: Show a sample CSV with two similar entries. Voiceover: “Which of these needs a second look?”
6–15s: Upload the clearly labeled sample file. Keep the cursor and upload result visible.
15–32s: Open one flagged pair and explain the matching fields. Say “possible duplicate,” not “error found.”
32–40s: Demonstrate the reviewer keeping or dismissing the flag.
40–45s: Invite viewers to try it with an appropriate CSV.

Record only this flow. Use sample data visibly labeled as such. No customer savings or accuracy claims; none were supplied.
